TAMBERLY POWELL, MS, RDN

Finding Accurate Sources of Health and Nutrition 
Information 
In this unit, we’ve already discussed how to fact-check health claims encountered in the news or 
on social media and how to assess expertise in the field of nutrition. On this page, we expand 
our information literacy toolkit to include strategies for searching for accurate sources of health 
and nutrition information. These approaches become more important if you’re seeking answers to 
a specific question, writing a paper for a class, or building your knowledge base for personal or 
professional reasons.
